title: The Slow Kitchen
author: P. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
